# googleworkspace_org_unit (Data Source)

Looks up a single Google Workspace organizational unit by its full path.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "googleworkspace_org_unit" "board" {
  org_unit_path = "/SMI Board"
}

output "board_org_unit_id" {
  value = data.googleworkspace_org_unit.board.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `org_unit_path` (String) Full path of the organizational unit, e.g. `/Engineering/Frontend`.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description of the organizational unit.
- `id` (String) Immutable organizational unit ID.
- `name` (String) Name of the organizational unit.
- `parent_org_unit_path` (String) Full path of the parent organizational unit.
